title: Cohort Mosaic Sampler for Per-Domain Calibration Bundles
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and implement a novel 'Cohort Mosaic' sampling pipeline that produces compact, per-domain calibration packs optimized for FP8/INT8 quantization and downstream accuracy validation. The sampler should balance recency, semantic diversity, request length distribution, and signal importance (errors/edge-cases) while respecting tenant privacy and quota constraints. Output packs must be reproducible, auditable, and compatible with our offline quantization harness.
background: Existing calibration packs are large and either over-index on high-frequency routes or under-represent rare but high-impact failure cases. Prior tickets explored stratified and reservoir samplers but left gaps in cross-domain representativeness and operational reproducibility. We need a production-friendly approach that gives per-domain engineers a predictable pack (<=20k examples) with tunable coverage guarantees for FP8/INT8 calibration runs.
goals: 1) Produce per-domain packs with explicit coverage quotas across recency, semantic clusters, length strata, and failure signal. 2) Make packs reproducible and indexed for auditability. 3) Keep pack size configurable (default 10k-20k examples). 4) Provide clear telemetry for calibration runs and downstream accuracy validation.
sampling_strategy_summary: Cohort Mosaic = layered quotas: (A) recency window prioritization (exponential decay), (B) semantic clustering (embedding k-means with cluster quota), (C) length and token-footprint strata, (D) rarity and failure-boost (weight multiplier for low-frequency tokens/failed responses), (E) exemplar anchors (retain canonical exemplars per cluster), (F) shard-aware reservoir to ensure cross-partition fairness.
algorithm_steps: Ingest 90-day production traffic per-domain; compute metadata (route, tenant tier, token_count, latency, error_flag)
Compute semantic embeddings using the 'runtime-calib-embed-v2' model and cluster into 200-500 clusters per domain
Assign cluster quotas proportional to cluster mass with floor/ceiling constraints to avoid dominance
Apply recency-weighted sampling inside clusters using decay factor lambda (configurable per domain)
Boost examples flagged by failure signals or low-frequency tokens by a multiplicative factor and cap boosted share at 15%
Reserve 5-10% of pack for manual anchor exemplars provided by domain owners
Perform shard-aware reservoir sampling across ingestion shards to prevent partition bias
Deterministically seed RNG with domain+date+run-id to ensure reproducibility
Output pack with provenance metadata: sample_score, cluster_id, original_request_id, tenant_hash (salted), and sampling_seed
calibration_pack_schema: items: list of (request_id, masked_prompt, token_count, cluster_id, sample_score, signals)
anchors: list of anchor exemplars with owner and justification
validation_plan: Run FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles on each pack using offline quant-harness (github.com/redwood/runtime-quant-harness PR #128)
Compute delta metrics vs baseline (fp32) including per-token logit gap, perplexity delta, and downstream task accuracy (QA/retrieval/rewrite tests)
Run stratified holdout A/B: split each pack into calibration/holdout and evaluate regression on holdout
Surface per-cluster and per-length-strata regressions in Console dashboards (per-route breakdown)
If regressions exceed thresholds, trigger automatic rollback and create a regression incident ticket with top offending exemplars
success_metrics: Median perplexity delta (quant vs fp32) < 2% across holdout
< 5% of clusters show significant degradation (>5% relative loss) after quantization
Pack reproducibility: same seed + params produces identical pack >99.9% of items
Calibration run cost per pack < budgeted GPU-hours (TBD per release)
updates: 2026-02-18: Ticket created after sync with PM and two domain owners (payments, search). Initial PRD linked.
2026-02-22: Prototype clustering pipeline validated on 3 domains; cluster counts of 300-450 looked stable. Observed high overlap with prior reservoir samples but improved tail coverage.
2026-02-26: First deterministic seeding implemented; discovered minor non-determinism due to parallel data-frame shuffles — fixed by centralizing sort-by-id before sampling.
2026-02-28: Bench run for a 20k pack on payments domain: quant-harness FP8 showed 1.9% median perplexity delta; noted two clusters with >6% degradation — flagged for manual review.
2026-03-01: Incorporating domain-owner feedback to increase anchor exemplar budget from 5% to 10% for search domain; adding tenant-tier aware quotas as a follow-up task.
Next: land PR for sampler core, add unit tests for reproducibility, and schedule validation runs across 10 domains by 2026-03-12.
blockers: Privacy scrub pipeline change (ENG-82145) must be coordinated to ensure consistent masked_prompts — dependency on privacy rollout
Embedding model capacity: runtime-calib-embed-v2 CPU inference still slow on large windows; needs GPU offload to meet schedule
decisions: Use embedding-based clustering (k-means) rather than LDA/topic models due to embedding semantics aligning better with instruction-following failure modes
Cap boosted failure examples at 15% to avoid skewing overall distribution
Default pack size set to 15k, configurable per-domain (min 5k, max 50k)
Store salted tenant_hash instead of raw tenant_id to meet privacy constraints
